guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation table scroll accessibility focus
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), sequential heading levels, captioned tables with <th scope>, focusable scroll regions wired via aria-labelledby, and descriptive iframe titles.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned .doc-table tables in focusable .table-wrap regions with 3px :focus-visible outline, role='note' on Baseline banner, and descriptive title on the embedded showcase iframe.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical max-inline-size: 100% for responsive containers and embeds, horizontal scrolling for wide tables rather than clipping, and flex-wrap with gap for metadata pill lists.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap and .example-embed iframe use max-inline-size: 100%, with .compat-table and .scroll-table scrolling cleanly on 360px mobile and shared public/styles.css handling flex-wrap and code blocks.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table mobile overflow typography
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Rely on balanced heading wrapping and clean code/prose typography without per-page inline overrides that break dark-mode or narrow-screen wrapping.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: omitted inline overrides on h1, pre, code, and blockquote so shared public/styles.css typography and light-dark() tokens remain consistent.
